paper_metadata.title: Enhanced high-temperature strength and ductility of wire arc additive manufactured Al–Ce–Mg alloys with fine α-Al/Al11Ce3 eutectics
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

evidence.quote: Here, wire-arc additive manufacturing (WAAM) is employed to fabricate Al–Ce–Mg heat-resistant aluminum alloy, considering its capability to manufacture large complex structures more efficiently.
